abortPolicy.emailSearch: When looking for a key-delivery message, search only for a message whose body carries a 40-character hexadecimal token. Never widen the search to other messages, and never open a message on sender alone.
abortPolicy.keyMaterial: A key is never typed into chat, never written to a log, never sent to any CivicScope server (there is none for user keys), and never read back by the agent as proof. The only accepted proof of setup is the app's own re-validation event for that key.
abortPolicy.unexpectedScreen: Halt before any key entry, report key state by presence only (never key material), and hand off to the manual path at the step equivalent to the step where the halt happened.

approvalMechanics: An approval point is satisfied only by the human's explicit yes in the conversation at that step. The agent says in plain words what it is about to do and where, then waits. Silence, an earlier yes, or the agent's own judgement is never an approval.

gotos.abort-to-manual: Stop the run. Do not attempt the current step another way. Report key state by presence only, and tell the user which manual step to continue at: the step's manualEquivalent value.
gotos.report-and-stop: Stop the run. Report the observed text verbatim and do not retry unless the user explicitly asks. Report key state by presence only.
gotos.wait: Suspend the run and tell the user what is being waited for. There is no timer and no automatic polling: the agent re-checks only when the user says to look again, and never widens an email search.

handoff.entryPoint: The CivicScope app page's "Set up with your agent" section, anchored at #agent-handoff (src/ui/ai/agent-handoff.tsx, mounted in src/ui/App.tsx).
handoff.urlPattern: The app origin the user is already on, with the fragment #agent-handoff. No other origin serves this page.

census.label: Census API key
census.manualPath: F5b manual path: the in-app Census key prompt (open the signup form, paste the emailed key, the app validates before saving)
census.storage: localStorage on the CivicScope origin only (civicscope.censusKey.v1)

meta.label: Meta Model API key (personal, optional)
meta.manualPath: F5b manual path: the in-app personal-key settings (paste the key, the app validates with its own call before storing)
meta.storage: localStorage on the CivicScope origin only (civicscope.metaKey.v1)

census.action: Open the CivicScope agent-handoff link and read what the app says it needs.

checkpoint.expect: The handoff page states the Census key, the target origin, and the success event name (civicscope:census-key).

onFailure.note: Report what was found instead; do not improvise a different entry point.

census.action: Open the Census API key signup in the user's browser.

checkpoint.expect: The signup form is visible with its expected fields (name, email, organisation, activity).

humanApproval.label: Before submitting any form under the user's identity

onFailure.note: Hand off to the manual path at the signup step.

census.action: Submit the signup with the details the user provided.

onFailure.note: Report the rejection text verbatim and stop. Do not retry with altered details.
Hand off to the manual path at the signup step.

census.action: Read the key-delivery message in the user's mailbox.

checkpoint.expect: A message whose body contains a 40-character hexadecimal token. The token shape is the discriminator: no sender or subject is asserted here, because the repository records no verified one, so open a message only when it carries that token.

onFailure.note: Take the wait goto and tell the user (no timer, no polling). Never widen the email search beyond the token-shaped message.
Halt and hand off to the manual path at the key-retrieval step. Do not open any other message.

census.action: Place the token into the app's Census key field on the CivicScope origin only, so the app validates it and stores it in localStorage. The token goes from the email to the app field and nowhere else.

checkpoint.expect: The app's own re-validation succeeds: civicscope:census-key fires and the app shows the Census key active.

humanApproval.label: Before the credential is displayed or handled

onFailure.note: Report the app's stated reason and hand off to the manual path's validation guidance at the paste step. The token never enters chat or log output.
Halt before any key entry and hand off at the paste step.

census.action: Report setup complete. Report key presence only — never the key, never a fragment of it.

checkpoint.expect: The app shows the Census key active, confirmed by its own event, not by the agent.

meta.action: Open the CivicScope agent-handoff link and read what the app says it needs.

checkpoint.expect: The handoff page states the personal Meta key is optional, the target origin, and the success event name (civicscope:meta-key-changed).

onFailure.note: Report what was found instead; do not improvise a different entry point.

meta.action: Open dev.meta.ai in the user's browser. The user signs in with their own account — sign-in is the user's action, never the agent's.

checkpoint.expect: The Meta developer console is visible, signed in, with API key management reachable.

humanApproval.label: Before the agent proceeds inside the user's signed-in console

onFailure.note: Hand off to the manual path at the sign-in step.

meta.action: The user creates a new API key in the console. Key creation is the user's click; the agent directs and observes only.

checkpoint.expect: The console shows a newly created key.

humanApproval.label: Before the credential is displayed or handled

onFailure.note: Halt before the credential is displayed and hand off at the key-creation step.

meta.action: Direct the user to paste the key into CivicScope's personal-key settings on the CivicScope origin only. The app validates the key with its own validation call before storing it in localStorage.

checkpoint.expect: The app's own validation accepts the key: civicscope:meta-key-changed fires and the settings show the key stored.

humanApproval.label: Before the credential is displayed or handled

onFailure.note: Report the app's reason class (malformed / rejected / network) and hand off to the manual path's validation guidance at the paste step. The key never enters chat or log output.
Halt before any key entry and hand off at the paste step.

meta.action: Report setup complete. Report key presence only — never the key, never a fragment of it.

checkpoint.expect: The app shows a personal key stored, confirmed by its own event, not by the agent.

purpose: An AI agent walks a fresh user through obtaining and placing the two browser-held keys CivicScope can use — the free Census API key and an optional personal Meta Model API key — without the key material ever transiting CivicScope, appearing in agent output or logs, or being accepted as an agent report. Setup success is confirmed only by the app's own re-validation events, named per key below.
